title: Chat with a session in place

variants.label: Session picker
variants.about: The AI launcher (Ctrl+K → AI, or its dock button) gains a second tab next to New task: Sessions. It lists your Claude and Codex sessions, running ones first. Each row shows the provider, the title, the folder and its state: working (DNA loader), waiting for you, or idle. ↑ ↓ moves through the list and Enter opens one. The chat then appears right inside the launcher: the latest replies and tool rows in the run activity style, with a composer underneath. You can steer the session or answer it without going to Agent sessions. The pin button (Ctrl+Shift+P) docks this chat on the right side of the window; that is the "Pinned side" variant. New task keeps today's flow of starting a session from scratch. Build: Agent sessions already lists sessions and resumes them through each CLI (server/agent-sessions-api.ts). The launcher would reuse that list and the existing send and steer calls.

variants.label: Pinned side
variants.about: The chat pinned to the right side of the window. It is a frost-glass panel, 380 px wide, between the top bar and the dock, and the canvas keeps working in the space left of it. The header switches session in place (a dropdown with the same list as the picker, running ones first) and has Unpin and Open in Agent sessions. Below are the session's replies and tool rows, live, with the DNA loader on the current step. When the agent asks something, the question shows as an amber card with its answer buttons. The composer stays at the bottom. The panel stays put through focus mode and app switching, and it is restored after a restart. Ctrl+Shift+P toggles it and Ctrl+Shift+A jumps into its composer. Build: one docked panel component in App.vue that reuses AgentSessions' transcript rows and composer. The canvas viewport shrinks by the panel's width when pinned, so focus mode and Home fit the remaining space.
